name: Riverside Plaza
summary: Cheerful, classy retail center with a supermarket, specialty stores & casual dining, plus a cinema.
description: Galleria at Tyler is a premier shopping destination in Riverside featuring an extensive selection of retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. The center offers a modern shopping experience with a diverse mix of national brands and specialty stores to serve the Inland Empire community. With convenient access and ample amenities, it provides a comprehensive retail experience for visitors throughout the region.
demographics: The Galleria at Tyler serves the Inland Empire's diverse middle to upper-middle income families, with primary visitors aged 25-54 years old. The trade area encompasses suburban Riverside and surrounding communities with growing household incomes and a mix of young families and established professionals. Shoppers typically visit for both convenience and lifestyle needs, with strong preferences for value-oriented national brands, family dining options, and entertainment experiences that serve multi-generational households.
